title: Diagonal Firing Line
setup: The black king on e6 and the black queen on h3 stand on the same diagonal, and it is completely empty.
hint: Look for a check that lands on the diagonal the black queen is already standing on. What guards that square?
explanation:
## The Idea

The squares d7, e6, f5, g4 and h3 form one diagonal, king in front and queen at the far end. {{Qd7+}} steps onto it, and the bishop on **a4** covers d7 the instant the queen leaves b5, so the king cannot take. {{Kf6}}, then {{Qxh3}}.
